product: AI fitness coach PWA: deterministic programme engine plus Claude narrative, chat and letters
stack: Next.js 16 + React 19 monorepo; Postgres 16 (Neon) via Drizzle; better-auth self-hosted; Vercel; Anthropic, Resend, Mux, six wearable OAuth APIs
weakest_exit: Anthropic SDK structured-output calls and Mux-hosted video assets, both MEDIUM; everything else is one pg_dump
top_finding: Every AI task runs ungated on an Opus-tier model for every user, including a weekly letter to every registered profile, so LLM spend is £401k of a £414k monthly bill at 1M users against £36k revenue.
first_fix: Gate AI tasks behind entitlements() with a per-task model tier and per-user monthly cap inside packages/api/src/ai/client.ts, and restrict the weekly letter cron to users active in the last 14 days.
